question_text: Was the Steam outage a cyberattack?
answer_text: No source we read says either Steam disruption was an attack, and none rules one out. Valve has not given a cause. A spike in user reports does not show an attack.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: A Valve statement naming the cause, or a statement from CISA, the FBI or an outside investigator.
A Valve post-incident statement or status-page note naming the cause.

question_text: Was the Nov 17 outage planned maintenance?
answer_text: Reports and XDA call it maintenance, which Valve usually runs on Tuesday evenings, but Valve has not said so and it was bigger than usual.
label: Reported
what_would_settle_it: A Valve notice saying it was maintenance, or giving another cause.

question_text: Are the Nov 17 and Nov 20-21 disruptions connected?
answer_text: No source links them. IBTimes AU says it is unclear.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: Valve saying the events had the same cause or different causes.

question_text: What did users experience, and for how long?
answer_text: On Nov 17, downloads, Friends, cloud saves and the Store were down, back by about 6:35 PM ET. From late Nov 20, users reported sign-in failures, connection problems and checkout errors (E502 L2); still going into Saturday.
label: Reported
what_would_settle_it: Valve giving start and end times for each event.
